title: Am I crazy or is WDC the cleanest setup in tech right now?
summary: Idk why everyone is still fighting over NVDA and AMD at these valuations when the storage trade is sitting right there.I was messing around with some charts today and pulled up Western Digital ($WDC) and the structure is actually kind of wild. If you look at the image I attached, it’s been riding this perfect channel for months. Like, every time it dips to the bottom, it gets bought up instantly.We are sitting right under that $188 level (the green line). Feels like if it breaks that, there’s no resistance left at all.Plus they beat earnings like 3 times in a row, so it’s not just a hype train. It actually makes sense that AI needs massive storage, but nobody on my feed is talking about it.Does this look like a clear breakout to you guys or am I just seeing what I want to see? Feels almost too easy compared to the chop in the rest of the sector.Just sharing what I'm seeing, obviously do your own research.submitted by/u/Beyos[link][comments]
